title: Under-specified: shelf bracket
prompt: I need a bracket to hold up a small shelf.

hidden_tests.description: The model evaluates without feature errors
Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
A plausible amount of material (5 to 1500 cm³)

questions: How deep is the shelf and roughly how much weight will it carry?
What will it be screwed into (wood, drywall with anchors, masonry), and with which screws?
Do you want a plain L bracket or a braced/triangular one, and how will you make it (3D print, laser, CNC)?
clarify.assumptions: A ~150 mm deep shelf with a light load (books or plants up to ~5 kg), printed flat in PETG: a triangular bracket 150 mm along the wall, 120 mm along the shelf, 15 mm thick with 15 mm arms; screw holes drilled on install.
